In June 2025, the base year for comparing price levels across economies was updated from 2017 to 2021 (Alfani et al. 2025). PPPs are used to convert welfare data and national poverty lines from local currency units into dollars. a As part of the update, the global poverty lines were revised to reflect updated national poverty lines set by national authorities around the world. The World Bank’s global poverty lines are based on the national poverty lines that are used by governments to monitor poverty within national borders. context_candidates.text: To investigate the disproportionate impact, two methods allow variation in the intensity of the shock faced by households (Kimura et al. 2026). In both cases, the average growth of the economy is maintained at the level indicated in Global Economic Prospects, June 2026 (World Bank 2026c), which captures the aggregate income and price shock. First, households are allocated sectoral growth rates based on their sector of employment. Second, inflation is allocated to households depending on their budget’s exposure to food and energy. Poorer households typically spend a greater share on food and energy and thus receive lower real income if the prices of these items rise. A distribution-neutral assumption, which is used as the baseline throughout the report, would instead assume the equal distribution of inflationary shocks.

- Thu nhập của hộ có thể bị ảnh hưởng khác nhau tùy ngành nghề, vì cường độ sử dụng năng lượng khác nhau giữa các ngành [1aa1bf0b4526492748627f2094425ca5fb56345732b6530fbca56fd0c38a622f].
- Tác động của giá lương thực lên nghèo cùng cực phức tạp vì nhiều người nghèo là người sản xuất lương thực và có thể được hưởng lợi khi giá tăng; nhưng nếu giá tăng do chi phí đầu vào (phân bón, vận tải) thì không có lợi ích ròng cho người sản xuất, và họ có thể còn thiệt hơn nếu cầu giảm [01b19e099f5739adced97e1c1bb073e31f06a7dab5c1607a0ebb484a10bd76d4].

Kết luận: tài liệu cho thấy giá năng lượng ảnh hưởng ngân sách hộ trực tiếp và gián tiếp, nhưng việc hộ nghèo "nhạy cảm hơn" do tỷ trọng chi tiêu cao hơn chưa được xác nhận trong các đoạn đã truy xuất. Tác động của giá lương thực cũng phụ thuộc vào việc hộ là người mua hay người bán và nguyên nhân giá tăng.

Nearly two in three countries were facing weaker growth prospects in June 2026 compared with the outlook in Global Economic Prospects, January 2026 (World Bank 2026b, 2026c). According to the projections of Global Economic Prospects, June 2026 (World Bank 2026c), commodity prices were expected to rise by 22 percent in 2026, while, according to earlier projections in January 2026, they had been expected to decline by 7 percent in 2026 (World Bank 2026b). The higher commodity prices led to a resurgence of inflationary pressures similar to the situation observed at the start of the Russian Federation’s invasion of Ukraine, which resulted in a reduction in food production, particularly of wheat. Record maize harvests in South Africa (Crop Estimates Committee 2026) fixed fertilizer prices in some countries, such as India (PIB 2026), and the low take-up of fertilizers in Sub-Saharan Africa (FAO 2025) generally could mitigate the impact on food prices. Furthermore, the overall effect of higher food prices on extreme poverty is complicated by the fact that many of the poor are food producers and could thus benefit from higher food prices (Ivanic and Martin 2008). It is thus crucial to understand what happens to input costs. If the increase in food prices is driven by input costs (for instance, fertilizer or transport costs), there are no net benefits among food producers, who may even be less well off if there is a reduction in food demand.
